#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

int solve(int n, int k, int s, long long t) {
    while (t % n != 0) {
        int delta = (s < k ? 1 : -1) * static_cast<int>(t % n);
        s = (s + n + delta) % n;
        t--;
    }
    t /= n;

    vector<long long> when(n, -1);
    long long left = t;
    while (left > 0) {
        if (when[s] != -1) {
            long long period = when[s] - left;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (when[i] != -1 && when[i] <= when[s] && when[i] % period == 0) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
            assert(false); // Should not happen
        }
        when[s] = left;
        for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; --i) {
            if (s < k) {
                s += i;
                if (s >= n) s -= n;
            } else {
                s -= i;
                if (s < 0) s += n;
            }
        }
        left--;
    }
    return s;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k, s;
    long long t;
    cin >> n >> k >> s >> t;
    s--; // decrement as in Java code

    int result = solve(n, k, s, t);
    cout << result + 1 << "\n";

    return 0;
}
